sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ps.posting_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'Mentions RAG' ELSE 'Does not mention RAG' END AS rag_mention, median(f.comp_mid_usd) AS median_pay_midpoint FROM fct_posting f LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT posting_key FROM posting_skills WHERE skill = 'RAG') ps ON f.posting_key = ps.posting_key WHERE f.is_open = TRUE AND f.remote_us = TRUE AND f.is_canonical_listing = TRUE GROUP BY 1
